name: goodboy
description: Guided Codex pet generation workflows for Goodboy projects.

interface.shortDescription: Create Codex pets from source images.
interface.longDescription: Goodboy packages the guided Codex workflow for creating, validating, reviewing, and installing animated Codex pets from source images. It steers agents toward the start/advance rails, provenance capture, visual QA, and install safety gates.
defaultPrompt: Use Goodboy to start a Codex pet project.
Use Goodboy to continue this pet through QA.
Use Goodboy to review install readiness.
